adjustmentsFromBrief: Scope reduced to the 8 Mac boards per the 2026-11-16 Mac-first decision; mobile boards removed from the canvas.
Sidebar footer shows service and Agent API status instead of iPhone/iPad connection.
Settings drops Tailscale and device pairing (phase 2) and adds 備份／還原 (phase-1 production-ready requirement).
Conflict board reframed for phase 1: this window's edits vs a version an external editor wrote to disk.
Added onAccent token: dark accent #8EA2FF is light, so primary-button text must be dark (#161615, 7.56:1) instead of white.
Added scrim token per theme for dialogs.
Diffs use strikethrough/underline as well as color, so deletions and insertions do not rely on red/green hue alone.
Partial adoption is per-change checkboxes (DESIGN.md requires 採用／部分採用／捨棄); the brief listed only 採用／插入／重試／捨棄.
Restoring a revision or undoing an AI change creates a new revision instead of rewriting history.
Platform simulations use fixed neutral platform-like backgrounds, not the app theme.
keyboard: Visible focus ring on every control (2px accent, 2px offset).

Shortcuts declared with aria-keyshortcuts: ⌘F search, ⌘N new, ⌘/ visual/source, ⌘P preview, ⌘↩ adopt and esc discard inside the AI panel, ⌘Z undo. Only the AI panel keys are wired in the prototype (scoped onKeyDown; the canvas forbids global key handlers).
Text inputs that act on Enter ignore Enter while an IME is composing.

storage: Image post and video works stay Markdown-first: library/works/<id>/source.md with YAML front matter (type, title, images: ordered relative paths, cover: path or {time_seconds}, video: path, tags); the body is the plain-text description. Media live in the work's assets/ folder as files. Revisions snapshot source.md; every write carries base_revision / If-Match and returns 409 on a stale base.
External (mounted) folders keep the same front matter in the user's .md; media are referenced in place, never moved.
Per-platform copy reuses PlatformVariant (title, body, tags, cover_asset_id) plus an 'inherit' flag so a variant can follow the shared copy.
api: POST /api/v1/works {type: article|image|video, title?} — create by type.

PATCH /api/v1/works/:id {base_revision, title?, description?, tags?, images?: asset_id[] (full ordered list), cover?: {asset_id}|{time_seconds}, video_asset_id?} — one atomic, revisioned write; 409 on stale base.
GET /api/v1/works list items gain thumbnail {asset_id, kind, time_seconds?}, image_count, duration_seconds, orientation.
Cover frame: recommended client-side capture from the <video> element, uploaded as a normal image asset (no ffmpeg); alternative GET /api/v1/assets/:id/frame?t= needs ffmpeg in the server bundle.
PATCH /api/v1/works/:id/variants/:platform gains images?, cover?, inherit?.
Video understanding reuses the QC-023 AI job + estimate endpoints with the work's video asset; adopting a suggestion is a normal PATCH that creates an ai_accepted revision.
Missing media: list responses mark image/video refs as missing (existing MediaRef status) so the editor can show 檔案遺失.
Tabs are client-only (app preferences: ordered work ids, active id, per-tab mode); restore uses GET /api/v1/works?ids=… to fetch titles/state in one call.

openQuestions.q: 貼圖與視頻作品怎麼存？
openQuestions.recommend: Markdown＋front matter：Finder 可讀，沿用現有 revision、409 與外部掛載。

openQuestions.q: 視頻封面幀從哪裡來？
options: App 從播放器截圖後上傳成素材
服務端用 ffmpeg 擷取
openQuestions.recommend: App 截圖：不必把 ffmpeg 打包進服務，也避開授權問題。

openQuestions.q: 公眾號貼圖張數上限？
openQuestions.recommend: 暫用 20 只提示，確認後寫進 PLATFORM_LIMITS。

openQuestions.q: 視頻平台文案怎麼分？
options: 共用文案＋各平台可覆寫
openQuestions.recommend: 共用＋覆寫：多數時候只寫一次，視頻號標題 16 字再單獨改短。

openQuestions.q: 長視頻（超過 1 小時）預設怎麼分析？
openQuestions.recommend: 低解析度全片：較便宜，且不漏掉後段。

openQuestions.q: 分頁數量要不要設上限？
options: 不設上限，溢出時捲動加全部分頁選單
openQuestions.recommend: 不設上限：自動關閉可能關掉還在用的作品。

openQuestions.q: 關閉未存分頁的選項？
options: 重試儲存／不儲存並關閉／取消
openQuestions.recommend: 重試儲存：內容本來會自動儲存，未存只會出現在寫入失敗時。

openQuestions.q: 重開 App 時恢復分頁的方式？
options: 全部恢復，只載入作用中的分頁
openQuestions.recommend: 全部恢復、延後載入：開得快，分頁也都在。

openQuestions.q: 英文介面裡的平台名稱？
openQuestions.recommend: 短名：計數列放得下；平台預覽內照平台原樣不翻譯。

openQuestions.q: 既有的混合類型作品怎麼顯示？

decisions.視頻封面幀從哪裡來？: App 從播放器截圖後上傳成素材（推薦），不打包 ffmpeg。
decisions.公眾號貼圖張數上限？: 暫用 20，只提示不阻擋，寫進 PLATFORM_LIMITS 並標 reference。
decisions.視頻平台文案怎麼分？: 共用＋各平台可覆寫（推薦）。
decisions.長視頻（超過 1 小時）預設怎麼分析？: 低解析度全片（推薦）；仍須先顯示預估費用，使用者確認才送出。
decisions.分頁數量要不要設上限？: 不設上限（推薦）。另加：同時保持載入的編輯器最多 8 個，其餘分頁卸載成未載入狀態，草稿與游標先存起來，點選時再載入。

decisions.重開 App 時恢復分頁的方式？: 全部恢復、只載入作用中的分頁（推薦）。
decisions.英文介面裡的平台名稱？: 用短名，但小紅書用 RedNote（不用 RED）：RedNote／WeChat OA／Douyin／Channels；平台預覽內照平台原樣。
decisions.既有的混合類型作品怎麼顯示？: 保留「混合」標籤，只出現在「全部」（推薦）。

decisions: AI 服務分成四個分頁（供應商、用途、用量、隱私），不是卡片提議的五段長頁：使用者明確不要長捲動；「隱私」與「僅本地模型」放在一起，用量與提醒金額獨立一頁。
供應商用「清單＋詳情」雙欄，不用點進去再返回：測試連線時左側列的狀態同步變化，一眼看到其他供應商；窄視窗才改為上下排列。
模型選擇只放在供應商詳情；「用途」頁只選預設供應商，模型跟著該供應商設定：同一個模型不在兩處設定。視頻理解目前只有 Gemini，列鎖定。
撤回告知只在供應商詳情；「隱私」頁列出每家內容送往哪裡與確認狀態，用「管理」跳到詳情，避免兩處操作同一件事。
測試連線結果用卡片呈現原因＋下一步（金鑰無效→更換金鑰；連不上→重試／檢查 Base URL；額度不足→重試），技術詳情單獨一列可複製，不含金鑰。
少文字：每頁不放副標；只保留做決定時需要的頁尾說明（服務常駐、只備份資料庫、金鑰只在鑰匙圈、估算以帳單為準、只在按下時送出）。

api: POST /api/v1/ai/providers/:provider/test (owner) → { ok, latency_ms, model_count, tested_at, error?: { code: invalid_key | unreachable | quota_exhausted | rate_limited | bad_response, http_status?, detail } }. Probe the free list-models endpoint (Gemini GET /v1beta/models, Anthropic GET /v1/models, OpenAI GET /v1/models, New API GET {base_url}/models), 10 s timeout, Keychain key never leaves the Mac or reaches logs; sent only when the user presses 測試連線. Fake services in tests.
Map 429 by provider error code: insufficient_quota / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED → quota_exhausted (額度不足); plain rate limit → rate_limited (shown as 暫時受限，稍後重試, not drawn).
Provider settings response gains last_test { status, at, latency_ms, model_count } so the list shows 連線正常 · 2 分鐘前 after restart; and base_url_host for New API so 隱私 can say where content goes.
Model list: generalise QC-054 GET /api/v1/ai/providers/:provider/models to every provider (known list as fallback, refresh=1); the test call can fill the same cache.
Defaults per task: GET/PUT /api/v1/ai/defaults { rewrite, title, video } (provider ids; video must be gemini). Absent → current behaviour (AI 工作台 picks).
Usage: existing GET /api/v1/ai/usage by_provider gains unpriced_jobs so New API runs on unpriced models show 無法預估 instead of US$0.00.
storage: No change to stored keys or provider settings. New: ai_defaults and last_test per provider in the service settings table (no key material). Last settings category and ⌘, are client preferences in the Mac app.

api: GET /api/v1/projects → items with work_count (excluding trashed), archived, color, sort_order; POST, PATCH /api/v1/projects/:id {name?, color?, archived?}, PUT /api/v1/projects/order {ids}.
DELETE /api/v1/projects/:id soft-deletes (deleted_at) and drops it from lists; POST /api/v1/projects/:id/restore for the undo toast; purge later. Works are never deleted.
GET /api/v1/works?project_id=…|unassigned=1 (unassigned = no live project; archived projects still count as membership); work items gain project_ids.
POST /api/v1/works/batch/projects {work_ids, add?: project_ids, remove?: project_ids} → per-item results like the QC-052 batch; POST /api/v1/works accepts project_ids.
GET /api/v1/projects/:id/summary → counts by status, last_updated_at, asset_count; GET /api/v1/assets?project_id=… = assets referenced by the project's live works (existing media refs).
Change events project.created/updated/deleted and work.projects_changed; contracts, api-client and agent-sdk CLI (list, create, add/remove works).

decisions: 保留「跟隨原文」並設為預設：寫作者常繁簡混用或中英並存；預設固定某一種語言，會讓「潤色一段繁體」悄悄變成簡體，違反「不改原意」。跟隨原文時依選取內容偵測（漢字以繁簡對照判斷、拉丁字母比例判斷英文），候選標示實際語言；偵測不出時用介面語言。
語言與模型是全域偏好，工具列與面板任一處改了就保存並同步（存服務端，三端共用）；prompt 若指定了模型或語言，套用那條 prompt 時以它為準，候選標示「prompt 指定」。
工具列的「更多」改名「Prompt」：它現在主要是指令選擇器；搜尋框同時接受直接輸入的指令，不必分兩個入口。
場景不符的指令淡化停用而不隱藏：使用者看得到它存在，也知道為什麼不能用。
內建指令唯讀、可複製成自訂：升級時內建內容可更新，不會覆蓋使用者的修改。
AI 建議指令走同一套候選＋diff＋保留，不直接覆蓋指令內容。

storage: prompts (id, name, group, scene: selection|full|title|image, content, model nullable, language nullable, sort_order, builtin bool, builtin_version, use_count, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at); reversible migration; built-ins seeded and upgradable without touching custom rows.
User preferences on the service: ai.output_language (follow|zh-Hans|zh-Hant|en), ai.text_model {provider, model}; shared by Mac, iPhone and iPad.
api: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/prompts, PUT /api/v1/prompts/order, POST /api/v1/prompts/:id/duplicate; GET /api/v1/prompts/export → JSON; POST /api/v1/prompts/import (same name → copy).
POST /api/v1/ai/prompt-suggestions {description, base_prompt_id?} → candidate text job; keeping it is a normal PATCH.
Every text AI job accepts prompt_id, language, model; the server expands variables ({選取} {標題} {全文} {平台} {語言}) and injects the language instruction; results carry detected_language and the model used.

fields.cover: cover_override nullable (asset or video frame); null = the work cover cropped to the platform ratio.
fields.images: image_order_override nullable (ordered asset ids, may hide images); null = images in source order. Images added to or removed from the source still appear/disappear; an override only orders and hides.
fields.tags: tags_override nullable; null = the work tags.

dataModel.overLimit: checkVariantLimits runs on the derived body. body_too_long gains cut_at (code-point index in the derived text) and source_offset (position in the Markdown source) so the preview can draw the cut line and 「在原稿標出第 1000 字」 can select that place in the editor. Never blocks a save and never truncates stored text.
dataModel.revisions: A variant revision is created only when an override changes (title/cover/images/tags or clearing one back to follow). Body edits are ordinary work revisions with the existing base_revision / 409 handling. Override PATCHes keep base_revision or If-Match; a 409 shows inside the field popover (「另一處改了這個平台的標題」 with keep mine / use theirs). Variant history lists override changes only.
dataModel.migration: Reversible migration. Existing variants: title/cover/images/tags become overrides when they differ from what the source gives, else null. If a variant’s saved body differs from the derived body (the user edited it), keep it as legacy body_override and show a one-line notice in the body popover: 「這個平台的正文是之前另外改過的版本」 with 「改回跟隨原稿」 (the old text stays in history). The `inherit` flag (QC-045/046) folds into “all fields follow”. Nothing is deleted.

api: GET /api/v1/works/:id/variants/:platform returns the resolved view: title, title_source (work|override), body (derived), body_source (work|legacy_override), cover, cover_source, images, images_source, tags, tags_source, warnings (with cut_at, source_offset), revision.

PATCH /api/v1/works/:id/variants/:platform accepts title / cover / images / tags as a value or null (null = back to following the work); base_revision or If-Match; 409 on a stale base. body is rejected for new variants (legacy body_override can only be cleared).

POST …/variants/:platform/draft and POST …/variants (generate) become unnecessary for the UI; keep them for older clients (generate = create empty override rows) and mark them deprecated in the API docs.
Change events: variant.changed only for override changes; previews re-derive on work.changed.
packages/platform-preview: deriveVariantBody(markdown, platform) → {text, blocks, map} shared by server and Mac (and later iPhone/iPad), plus limit checks on the result.
storage: platform_variants: add title_override, cover_override, image_order_override (JSON), tags_override (JSON), body_override (legacy only); stop writing body for new rows. Reversible migration as above.

權杖詳情：四個範圍各一列（名稱＋代號＋一句說明；write 明說不含正文）；「允許直接修改正文」開關預設關，打開時整列變警示色並說明會留快照、可恢復
直接修改確認：標題寫明 Agent 名稱；列出後果（不再經你採用）、保護（快照、歷史標示、一鍵恢復）、範圍（限定的項目；外部資料夾檔案同樣會被改寫）；需勾「我了解」，主按鈕為紅色「允許直接修改」，預設焦點在取消
可以動哪些項目：所有作品／只限這些項目（項目外看不到也改不了，新建的作品只能歸入這些項目）
最近活動：每筆有類型圖示（提案、歸入、新建、讀取、直接修改、被拒絕），寫明作品與結果，歸入可「復原」、直接修改可「恢復上一版」
項目設定（項目頁 ⋯ › 項目設定）：描述（Agent 會讀）、關鍵字、標籤、來源資料夾、來源網域；右側試算最近 20 個作品的分數、原因與結果（會自動歸入／只給建議／不歸入），並說明手動歸屬不會被覆蓋
作品卡：Agent 歸入的項目標籤改成藍框＋Agent 圖示；點開說明是誰、何時、自動或建議、分數與原因，可「保留（改為手動）」或「復原歸入」
歷史版本：標出「Agent 直接修改」（黃）、「Agent 提案」（藍）、「AI」（灰），直接修改的版本可一鍵恢復到上一版

decisions: 收件匣放在側欄頂部（全部作品、未分類下方）而不是工具區：提案是待你處理的作品變更，和作品範圍同級；數字徽章讓它不會被忽略。
同時在編輯頁右側邊欄加「提案」分頁：正在編輯的作品有提案時就地處理，正文高亮變更處。
部分採用：沿用 QC-022 AI 候選的逐處選擇；Agent 常一次改多處，全收或全捨都太粗。
有重疊時不能直接採用，必須先三方對照：避免 Agent 的舊版本蓋掉使用者之後的修改。
權杖設定移到 設定 ›「Agent 與 MCP」：權杖會越來越多、還有範圍、項目與活動，放在匯入任務頁太擁擠；匯入任務頁留一個連結即可。
直接修改的確認要勾「我了解」且主按鈕是紅色具體動詞：這是「嚴禁 AI 直接覆蓋原文」唯一的例外，預設焦點在取消。
Agent 說明一律當資料呈現（引號框＋「只作參考」），不讓它看起來像系統訊息。
項目規則附試算：讓使用者在儲存前看到規則會把哪些作品歸進來、為什麼。

api: Proposals (QC-089): GET /api/v1/proposals?status=pending|done&agent=…; GET /api/v1/proposals/:id with hunks (stable ids), base_revision, current_revision, overlap: none|stale|conflict and the overlapping hunk ids; POST …/:id/accept {hunk_ids?, base_revision} → new work revision with source agent_proposal + token name; POST …/:id/discard; counts for the sidebar badge; change events proposal.created/updated.
Three-way merge input for conflicts: base text, the user’s current text and the proposal, per overlapping hunk.

Tokens: PATCH /api/v1/tokens/:id {scopes, allow_direct_body_edit, project_ids|null}; turning allow_direct_body_edit on needs the owner token and is logged; GET /api/v1/tokens/:id/activity (change_log by token: type, target, result, reason, revision).
Direct edits: work revision source agent_direct with token name and the snapshot revision; POST /api/v1/works/:id/revisions/:rev/restore already exists for one-click restore.

Projects (QC-092): PATCH /api/v1/projects/:id {description, rules: {keywords, tags, folders (mount ids or paths), domains}}; POST /api/v1/projects/:id/rules/preview {rules} → recent works with score, reasons, outcome (auto ≥ 0.8, suggest 0.5–0.8) without saving.
Work-project membership carries added_by {kind: user|agent, token, auto, score, reasons, at}; PATCH to “keep” converts to user; undo removes only agent-added rows.
backendNeeds.mcpSync: Every new route above needs an MCP tool or an exclusion with a reason (proposal accept/discard and token management are owner-only exclusions).

references.borrowed: One change per row with what changes, the result and where.
references.adaptation: Each hunk is its own block with a label, the inline diff and a checkbox, so changes can be accepted individually.

references.borrowed: Name the risky action with a concrete verb and keep button meaning stable; default focus on cancel.
references.adaptation: The direct-edit dialog says exactly what happens, needs an acknowledgement, uses a red 「允許直接修改」 and focuses 取消.

references.borrowed: Let people and agents share a checkable work object; show which parts an external agent changes and keep undo.
references.adaptation: Proposals highlight the exact passages in the editor; history marks agent-direct edits with one-click restore.

references.borrowed: A settings page that lets you inspect what an agent did and review a queue.
references.adaptation: Per-token recent activity with results and undo links in 設定 › Agent 與 MCP.

references.borrowed: Clear states and last-updated time for agent work; don’t confuse “agent says done” with verified.
references.adaptation: Proposal rows show status (pending, stale, conflict) and time; accepting is always the user’s step.

references.borrowed: Named agent profiles with their own settings; appearance is not a permission boundary.
references.adaptation: Each token is shown as a named agent with an avatar, but scopes and project limits are explicit controls, not implied by the persona.

references.borrowed: List states and failure paths explicitly.
references.adaptation: Covered pending, stale, conflict, denied and direct-edit states in the prototype.

verified: Rendered nine screenshots with headless Chromium and checked them by eye (fixed: segmented controls, per-token activity lists, adopt disabled on conflict).

openQuestions.q: 收件匣入口放側欄頂部（作品範圍旁）可以嗎？
openQuestions.recommendation: 可以；另在編輯頁右側邊欄加「提案」分頁。

openQuestions.q: 要不要允許部分採用？
openQuestions.recommendation: 要，逐處勾選（沿用 QC-022）。

openQuestions.q: 有重疊時能否強制採用？
openQuestions.recommendation: 不能，先三方對照；三方對照畫面另做（可沿用版本衝突頁）。

openQuestions.q: 權杖設定搬到 設定 ›「Agent 與 MCP」？
openQuestions.recommendation: 是；匯入任務頁留連結。

openQuestions.q: 打開直接修改要不要再輸入 Agent 名稱確認？
openQuestions.recommendation: 不用，勾「我了解」＋紅色具體按鈕已足夠；之後每次直接修改都留快照可恢復。

openQuestions.q: 自動歸入的分數門檻？
openQuestions.recommendation: ≥ 0.8 自動歸入、0.5–0.8 只給建議（可在項目設定調整，之後再做）。

openQuestions.q: 被捨棄的提案保留多久？
openQuestions.recommendation: 30 天，和最近刪除一致。

states: 作品卡「工作中」：一道光沿卡片外框慢速繞行（2.4 秒一圈，強調色，只在外框，不動內容）；封面左上角 Agent 標籤（權杖頭像＋名稱＋步驟文字，步驟前三點輪流亮起）；新建中還沒有封面時用骨架取代佔位文字
多個 Agent：頭像疊放，名稱寫「Claude Code 等 2 個」，步驟取最新回報；同一個 Agent 處理多件作品時每張卡各自顯示
剛完成：外框亮綠一次後 1.2 秒淡出，標籤換成「✓ 已新建並上傳 6 張圖片」，8 秒後淡出回到閒置
需要你處理：提案待審（黃框＋「審閱提案」）、出錯（紅框＋「重試 2 張」），靜態不動，處理前一直保留
可能已停止：工作中超過 2 分鐘沒有任何動作或回報 → 停止動畫，虛線框＋「3 分鐘沒有回報」；再過 10 分鐘回到閒置（活動記錄保留）
閒置：不顯示任何標示
列表模式：左緣 3px 狀態條（工作中為上下流動的光、提案黃、出錯紅、完成綠閃一次）＋Agent 欄
側欄：「全部作品」與每個項目的計數前加「● 2」，表示目前有幾個 Agent 在這裡工作（呼吸點）；點開列出 Agent、件數、作品名，和「Agent 活動記錄 ›」
頁首：項目名旁「● 2 個 Agent 工作中」
編輯頁：分頁標籤前的呼吸點；頁首下方提示條「X 正在處理這件作品…」＋各 Agent 的步驟；只能提案的 Agent 註明不會直接改正文；圖片佔位上顯示哪個 Agent 在配圖
你同時編輯（Agent 可直接改正文時）：黃色提示「你的修改先留在這個視窗；它寫入後會請你對照合併，不會互相覆蓋」＋「看它改了什麼」
減少動態效果：外框改為靜態強調色、三點改為靜態、骨架不閃、呼吸點不動，用顏色、圖示和文字表達狀態

decisions: 動效只在外框繞行，不動卡片內容、不縮放、不發光：有質感但不搶眼，捲動大量卡片時也不會亂；用 transform／conic-gradient，不觸發版面重排。
Agent 身分用權杖頭像＋名稱放在封面左上角：一眼看出是誰，和作品狀態標籤（底部）分開。
步驟文字由 Agent 主動回報才顯示；沒有回報時只顯示「工作中」，不假造進度。
逾時：2 分鐘無動作轉「可能已停止」，10 分鐘回閒置，避免永遠轉圈。
需要你處理的狀態不做動畫：需要決定的事用靜態顏色和按鈕，動效只表示「正在進行」。
同時編輯時不鎖定正文：只能提案的 Agent 不會衝突；可直接修改的 Agent 走既有 base_revision／409，介面提示你的修改不會被覆蓋。

dataSource.recommendation: Both: the server derives a baseline state from each token’s recent operations, and agents may report steps and completion through a new MCP tool. Implementation goes to qc-backend as QC-096.
dataSource.derived: From change_log per (token, work): any write/import/propose in the last 60 s → working; a proposal pending → needs_attention; a failed job → error; last activity 60 s–2 min ago with an open report → still working; 2–10 min with no activity → stale; then idle.
dataSource.reported: New MCP tool agent_status_report {work_id | work_ids, state: working|done|needs_attention|error, step?: short text (≤ 24 chars, shown as data), ttl_seconds?: default 120}; done shows for 8 s; reports expire at ttl so a crashed agent never spins forever.
dataSource.delivery: Server pushes agent.activity events over the existing change stream; GET /api/v1/agents/activity?work_ids=… for initial state; per-project and global counts for the sidebar.
dataSource.privacy: Step text is the agent’s own words; treat as data (no links, no markup), truncate, and never show tokens or file paths beyond the work.

references.borrowed: Name each background agent task and show its running state with a way to the result.
references.adaptation: Each card names the agent and its step; the sidebar lists agents with their works and links to the activity log.

references.borrowed: Show that an agent works in the background without interrupting the foreground; keep target and status visible.
references.adaptation: The agent’s presence sits on the card edge and a small label, never taking focus; in the editor a bar names the agent and its step while the user keeps typing.

references.borrowed: Pick skeleton, spinner or progress by task; never fake progress.
references.adaptation: Skeleton for a cover that doesn’t exist yet, a calm border sweep for “working”, and no percentage unless the agent reports one.

references.borrowed: Clear state definitions with last update time; agent “done” is not the same as verified.
references.adaptation: Five states with explicit timeouts; 「需要你處理」 stays until the user acts.

references.borrowed: Route by severity; not every progress update deserves attention.
references.adaptation: Working and done are ambient (animation, fades); needs-attention and errors are persistent and actionable; nothing pops up.

references.borrowed: State variants of icons plus text, checked at small sizes and with reduced motion.
references.adaptation: Each state has its own icon (dots, check, inbox, warning, clock) and words, so reduced motion keeps every state readable.

openQuestions.q: 工作中的動效用「光繞外框」可以嗎？（替代：封面上方細進度條、卡片輕微呼吸）
openQuestions.recommendation: 光繞外框；不動內容，最安靜也最容易一眼看出。

openQuestions.q: 步驟文字要不要顯示？
openQuestions.recommendation: 要，但只在 Agent 主動回報時顯示，最多約 24 字。

openQuestions.q: 逾時門檻？
openQuestions.recommendation: 2 分鐘沒動作轉「可能已停止」，10 分鐘回閒置。

openQuestions.q: 「剛完成」停留多久？
openQuestions.recommendation: 8 秒後淡出。

openQuestions.q: 側欄要不要顯示 Agent 計數？
openQuestions.recommendation: 要，「全部作品」與項目旁顯示「● N」，點開看是誰。

openQuestions.q: 資料來源？
openQuestions.recommendation: 服務端推導＋Agent 主動回報（新 MCP 工具 agent_status_report，帶 TTL），交 qc-backend 做 QC-096。

openQuestions.q: 同時動畫的卡片上限？
openQuestions.recommendation: 只動畫畫面內的卡片；超過 12 張同時工作時改為靜態外框，避免耗電。

openQuestions.q: 單擊素材要進到哪一層？A 燈箱（全視窗，蓋住素材庫）、B 圖庫檢視（主區內，保留側欄導覽與縮圖條）、C 網格內展開
openQuestions.recommendation: B。內容幾乎和燈箱一樣大，但不離開素材庫，← → 和縮圖條讓整理一批素材很順；空白鍵仍可開全視窗燈箱。

openQuestions.q: 資訊卡要不要記住上次開關？
openQuestions.recommendation: 不記住，每次進檢視都收起；需要時按 I。內容優先是預設。

openQuestions.q: 底部縮圖條要不要？
openQuestions.recommendation: 要，84px 高；它也是目前位置的提示。

openQuestions.q: 檢視中的空白鍵做什麼？
openQuestions.recommendation: 視頻／音訊：播放暫停；圖片／Markdown：開全視窗燈箱（QC-077）。

openQuestions.q: 檢視中圖片能不能縮放？
openQuestions.recommendation: 可以，沿用 QC-077 的捏合、⌘＋／⌘－／⌘0 與雙擊切換「適合／100%」。

openQuestions.q: Markdown 素材只排版閱讀，還是也能切原始文字？
openQuestions.recommendation: 預設排版閱讀，「更多」選單提供「顯示原始文字」與「複製文字」；不在這裡編輯。

openQuestions.q: 多選時原本的批次側欄（MultiInspector）怎麼辦？
openQuestions.recommendation: 取消，批次動作移到頁首動作列。
